items.title: Antonelli fastest, but Verstappen inherits Las Vegas pole
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli set 1m 33.893s on his final Q3 effort, 0.258s clear of Max Verstappen, but serves a five-place grid drop for power-unit changes. Verstappen therefore inherits pole, George Russell is on the front row and Antonelli starts sixth.
items.why_it_matters: The fastest car on Friday is not on pole, so the grid order overstates Red Bull's and understates Mercedes' race pace. Antonelli's recovery from sixth is a key storyline.

sources.label: Formula1.com: Verstappen reacts to inheriting pole
Formula1.com: Antonelli on his big risk

items.title: The tow decided qualifying; Red Bull and McLaren may pay for it in the race
items.summary: Russell called the tow 'insane' and Toto Wolff said he had no idea how the lap times came together; The Race describes the gain as 'crazy'. Formula1.com's strategy guide says FP3, the only dry practice, showed Red Bull and McLaren quicker through the twisty middle sector but losing almost a second to Mercedes on the straights.
items.why_it_matters: Qualifying hid that straight-line deficit; in the race it could reshuffle the order quickly, with Norris already wary of McLaren's speed deficit.

sources.label: The Race: what the tow was worth

items.title: Power-unit drops reshape the grid, including Antonelli, Piastri, Sainz and Stroll
items.summary: Antonelli drops five places, Piastri, Sainz and Stroll ten each, and Bearman, whose penalty exceeds 15 places, goes to the back. Leclerc's 11th on the road becomes 10th on the grid because of Piastri's drop.
items.why_it_matters: Check the final starting grid rather than the qualifying classification when quoting positions on air.

sources.label: Formula1.com on Antonelli, Bearman and Stroll

items.title: Ferrari's worst qualifying of 2026: both cars out in Q2
items.summary: Leclerc was 11th, just over a tenth short of Q3 after aborting his second Q2 run with a Turn 7 mistake; Hamilton was 12th, about half a second off. Leclerc calls it 'a very poor Qualifying'.
items.why_it_matters: Ferrari braced for a tough time on the long straights but a double Q2 exit is their worst result of the season, leaving them to recover through the field.

sources.label: Formula1.com: Leclerc and Hamilton lament performance
The Race: what explains Ferrari's worst qualifying

items.title: Russell tops FP3 and touches Verstappen at Turn 14
items.summary: Russell led the only dry practice with 1m 34.041s from Antonelli and Norris. Late on, Verstappen passed Russell before Turn 14, Russell tried to re-pass and there was light contact; the stewards were to investigate after the session.
items.why_it_matters: Verstappen and Russell now share the front row, so their rivalry into Turn 1 and the first stint is the obvious flashpoint.
